  - paragraph: DRAMA STUDIOS is an independent game studio based in Rennes, France. We focus on creating immersive, gameplay-driven experiences through close collaboration between design, art, and technology.
  - heading "About UNRECORD" [level=2]
  - paragraph: DRAMA STUDIOS is currently developing UNRECORD, a narrative open-world tactical FPS built with Unreal Engine 5.
  - paragraph: UNRECORD aims to deliver a highly immersive experience through realism, systemic gameplay, and a strong narrative approach. The project sits at an AA ambition level, combining creative freedom with solid production pipelines and technical rigor.
  - paragraph: Our goal is to craft believable worlds, meaningful player interactions, and gameplay systems that feel grounded, intense, and coherent.
  - heading "THE ROLE" [level=2]
  - paragraph: "You create high-quality 3D characters for UNRECORD: full characters, clothing, and accessory pieces, built with a classic AAA production pipeline and digital tailoring tools. Your work contributes to the visual fidelity and believable detail of our world."
  - paragraph: The role calls for a strong artistic culture, solid anatomy skills, and a good understanding of fabrics, so that character designs read as grounded and visually striking in the game.
  - heading "RESPONSIBILITIES" [level=2]

    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Create high-fidelity 3D character models, textures, and material setups in line with the realistic visual style of the project
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Sculpt high-poly models, then produce clean retopology suitable for deformation, efficient UV layouts, and baked maps (normal, AO, curvature, etc.)
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Author photorealistic PBR textures and material instances for real-time use
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Work with Technical Art, Animation, and Design so that assets meet runtime performance budgets and technical constraints
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Keep file structures clean and integrate character assets into the engine pipeline
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Take part in asset reviews and iterate on feedback from art direction and playtests
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Build characters from existing concepts, and contribute to character design upstream, in 2D or directly in 3D, when needed
  - heading "REQUIREMENTS" [level=2]
  - list:

      - paragraph: Experience in 3D character art or asset-focused roles for real-time applications
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: A portfolio showing realistic character work; personal projects, mods, and demos are welcome
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Excellent command of industry-standard tools (ZBrush, Maya, Blender, Substance 3D Painter, Marvelous Designer, etc.)
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Strong understanding of human anatomy, proportions, silhouette, and cloth behavior
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Solid grasp of the classic AAA character pipeline (high-to-low poly workflows, UVs, PBR texturing)
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Broad artistic culture (games, film, visual arts, photography)
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Creative mindset and careful attention to detail
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Comfortable working hands-on in production
    - listitem:

    - listitem:

    - listitem:

    - listitem:

    - listitem:

    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Ability to produce 2D concept art or quick visual iterations in early design phases is a plus
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: A passion for open-world and/or FPS games is a plus

  - text: Senior Systems Game Designer
  - img "🌎"
  - text: Remote (North America) 20 days ago Full TimeSenior (5+ years)
- article:
  - text: Senior Level Designer
  - paragraph: "Location: Remote — North America Level: Senior / Experienced Contract: Full Time"
  - paragraph: AstroNomad Studios is a new, small, distributed game studio backed by AIC. We are building original, expressive games with strong mechanical identity, memorable worlds, and a focus on player discovery, mastery, and adventure.
  - paragraph: We are looking for a Senior Level Designer to design, block out, test, and refine level spaces for our current third-person action/adventure project, with a particular focus on traversal, exploration, encounter flow, 360 degree spatial readability, and player discovery.
  - paragraph: This is a hands-on senior design role for someone who can turn abstract creative and gameplay goals into clear, playable spaces; iterate quickly in-engine; communicate design intent clearly; and help a small team build levels that are readable, memorable, and achievable.
  - heading "WHAT YOU’LL DO" [level=2]
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Design, block out, and iterate level spaces that support traversal, exploration, combat, discovery, pacing, and player mastery.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Create playable greyboxes/blockouts that make player pathing, landmarks, routes, risks, rewards, and encounter intent clear.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Work closely with creative direction, systems design, combat, art, animation, engineering, and production to ensure levels are fun, readable, buildable, and aligned with the project’s goals.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Translate high-level world and gameplay direction into practical layouts, traversal beats, encounter setups, discovery moments, and implementation-ready notes.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Design spaces that guide the player through composition, silhouette, landmarks, affordances, framing, pacing, and environmental logic rather than relying only on explicit markers.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Prototype and refine traversal-heavy spaces based on feel, camera behavior, readability, failure recovery, pacing, and playtest feedback.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Identify level design risks early, including unclear routes, overcomplicated layouts, weak recovery points, poor landmarking, poor encounter pacing, or spaces that exceed scope.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Collaborate with artists and technical team members to move levels from greybox toward shippable content while preserving design intent.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Support the creation of a game that rewards curiosity, movement, exploration, experimentation, danger, and player discovery.
  - heading "WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR" [level=2]
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Demonstrated experience designing 3D levels for action, action-adventure, traversal-heavy, exploration-focused, platforming, combat, or similarly spatially demanding games.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: "Strong spatial design instincts: you understand player flow, readability, landmarks, route choice, pacing, sightlines, scale, encounter setup, and environmental affordances."
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Hands-on ability to build and iterate playable blockouts/greyboxes in a modern game engine or comparable 3D tool.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Ability to turn creative goals and gameplay mechanics into practical spaces that can be tested, improved, and built by a small team.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Understanding of third-person gameplay considerations, including camera, movement feel, collision, failure recovery, checkpoints, player guidance, and spatial clarity.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Experience using playtest feedback to diagnose and improve level layouts.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain level intent through diagrams, notes, walkthroughs, blockouts, and practical documentation.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Comfort working in a small team where roles may overlap, priorities may evolve, and ownership matters.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Good taste in level design — not just adding more paths, objects, or setpieces, but knowing what should be simplified, clarified, emphasized, or removed.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: "A practical mindset: you care about what can actually be built, tested, polished, and improved."
  - heading "PREFERRED EXPERIENCE" [level=2]
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Shipped-title experience or equivalent production experience taking levels from concept/blockout through iteration, implementation, polish, and release.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Strong Unreal Engine experience, especially building, testing, scripting, or iterating level spaces in-engine.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Background in third-person action-adventure, traversal-heavy games, combat spaces, platforming, exploration-focused design, or stylized adventure games.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Experience designing vertical spaces, traversal routes, optional paths, secrets, shortcuts, risk/reward routes, or environmental challenges.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Experience collaborating with environment art, animation, combat design, systems design, engineering, and production.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Experience with encounter layout, enemy placement, pacing, checkpoints, failure recovery, and player onboarding.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Comfort working remotely with a distributed team.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Interest in stylized, expressive, mythic, strange, adventurous, or highly atmospheric worlds.
  - heading "ABOUT ASTRONOMAD STUDIOS" [level=2]
  - paragraph: AstroNomad Studios is the game-development arm of AIC. We are a new studio building a small, focused, distributed team around original games with strong mechanical identity and expressive worlds.
  - paragraph: We are drawn to games that combine movement, danger, discovery, mastery, atmosphere, and adventure — games where level spaces are not just containers for gameplay, but part of how the player understands and inhabits the world.
  - paragraph: We are early, ambitious, and practical. That means we care about distinctive creative direction, but also about scope, clarity, ownership, and making decisions a small team can actually execute.
  - paragraph: If you like building spaces that support movement, exploration, danger, readability, atmosphere, and meaningful player choice — not just isolated challenges or decorative environments — this may be a strong fit.
  - heading "HOW TO APPLY" [level=2]
  - paragraph: "Please include as much of the following as you can:"
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Your resume and/or portfolio.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Examples of levels, blockouts, greyboxes, shipped spaces, prototypes, or playable layouts you directly contributed to.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: If available, before/after examples showing how a level changed through playtesting, iteration, or team feedback.
    - listitem:
      - paragraph: Any relevant engine, scripting, documentation, diagramming, or collaboration examples.
    - listitem:

- article:
  - heading "Job Description" [level=2]:
    - strong: Job Description
  - paragraph: Ok, you tried the corporate marketing route and decided it’s not for you, yet spraying graffiti didn’t quite get you famous, though you still want to continue in the creative field? Cool — your determination deserves respect. Keep reading.
  - paragraph: "At Black Soup, we spend our day-to-day cooking up creator campaigns for the gaming industry. We have made it our mission to spread the word about that new game you’ve never heard of but will completely take over your life. Our weapon of choice: content creators. We don’t shy away from leveraging their influence in unique and creative ways to forge memorable moments for them and their communities."
  - paragraph: We do so as a cohesive unit, relentlessly thriving for pragmatic creativity - ask about it during your interview - and operational excellence. We foster ambition and curiosity without forgetting our humble beginnings. We play video games until 2am on a Tuesday and still show up locked and loaded the next morning to conquer the wild west of YouTube, Twitch, and TikTok.
  - paragraph: Problem is, we’re often too busy cooking up creator campaigns for our clients to be working on our own branding. That’s where you come in!
  - paragraph: We have the vision, now we’re looking for the designer - someone who can make us look good both in freeze frame as well as in full motion.
  - paragraph: Warning! This position is not your usual job role. We are looking for a creative all-rounder who can take on both the strategical parts of marketing, as well as the execution thereof - and then some.
  - paragraph: "The details of your mission are as follows:"
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - strong: "Represent the brand:"
      - text: Establish and elevate Black Soup’s visual guidelines, ensuring our brand looks sharp and cohesive across all internal and external touchpoints.
    - listitem:
      - strong: Chart our marketing strategy
      - text: ": How do you make a gaming influencer marketing agency stand out? Who’s the target audience and how do you reach them? Those will be your questions to answer and plan for."
    - listitem:
      - strong: "Drive our visual presence:"
      - text: Act as the artistic powerhouse driving our visual presence forward. Design eye-catching assets for our campaigns, pimp our pitch decks, and create slick
      - link "showreels" [e28]:
        - /url: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wi_SLCXXBmA
      - text: .
    - listitem:
      - strong: "Develop our showroom:"
      - text: It’s your job to make our team and our work look good. Be it by crafting case studies, writing up newsletters to share our adventures with the world or spreading our knowledge in articles. Leave your writer’s block at the door cause we need a copywriter.
    - listitem:
      - strong: "Weaponize social media:"
      - text: You’ve created the content, now you bring it to the masses and do so in a consistent way (eg. by writing a monthly newsletter). But it doesn’t end there. You’ll need to be self-critical and constantly look for ways to improve the content we put out to find what engages best.
    - listitem:
      - strong: Master our merch
      - text: ": We’ve already created Black Soup stickers, pins, mugs, coasters, hoodies, shirts, socks, beanies, frisbees, puzzles, cocktails, … and the list goes on. We want moar, yet we need you to make sure our merch stands out and lasts."
    - listitem:
      - strong: Organise events
      - text: ": You’ll be working together with our sales and marketing team to manage our presence at events. Sometimes this may mean developing new business cards, other times it may mean organizing a full-blown dinner or mixer for our clients and partners."
    - listitem:
      - strong: "Pick up a camera:"
      - text: On occasion, we may ask you to step out from behind your desk and get behind the lens. Whether it’s for a new team picture, recording a video case study, or supporting our creative campaign team with live productions.
  - paragraph: "Oof, that’s a lot. We know. Therefore, the artist we are looking for is:"
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - strong: Highly motivated
      - text: ": Where others see a wall, you see a way forward."
    - listitem:
      - strong: A creative allrounder
      - text: ": You can swap between graphic design, video editing and copywriting as if you have Sleight of Hand equipped. Aside from experience behind the screen, you have hands-on experience behind the lens for the occasional shoot."
    - listitem:
      - strong: Creator savvy
      - text: ": You have a proven understanding of the digital creator landscape, social media platform constraints and current visual tendencies across YouTube, Twitch and TikTok. In a past life you may have direct experience crafting assets for content creators, such as streaming overlays or social media assets for tournaments."
    - listitem:
      - strong: "An effective communicator:"
      - text: You master the ability to read and write in English. You can pitch and defend your design choices flawlessly and handle creative differences like a boss.
    - listitem:
      - strong: "Humble:"
      - text: While your creative ambition is high up in the sky, your ego is rooted firmly here on planet earth. You take constructive feedback as a tool to level up.
    - listitem:
      - strong: "Gamer to the core:"
      - text: You play games for breakfast. If we don’t smell your gamer instinct on you, it’s not gonna work out.
  - paragraph: "Here’s what you can expect from us:"
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - strong: A Berlin office
      - text: featuring lovely colleagues, a big gaming setup, summer BBQs, doggos and more mate and coffee than the human body can endure. But you can also work from home if you prefer.
    - listitem:
      - strong: An inclusive team culture
      - text: where your voice is heard, your ideas are celebrated, and bad jokes are mandatory.
    - listitem:
      - strong: A long term job offer
      - text: featuring a salary of €40-50k depending on your skill level. Add on to that a quarterly team bonus, more Steam keys than you can handle, Urban Sports, Jobrad, and an invite to our annual workcation week, typically somewhere sunny.
  - paragraph: Think you got what it takes?
  - paragraph: Send your portfolio, resume, and a brief introduction via the apply button below.
  - paragraph: Quick heads up. In the later stages of the interview process we will ask you to deliver on a marketing & design focused challenge.
  - paragraph: "PS: We welcome all kinds of people and expect the same from you."
